excerpt_i18n.en: On November 5, the new version of QQ Browser for desktop was launched, officially introducing the "AI+" mini-window. This built-in intelligent assistant tool integrates various AI capabilities deeply into users' browsing scenarios through a floating window. Users can access AI features via "manual activation" or "smart recommendations" without altering traditional usage habits, while receiving precise assistance, further enriching QQ Browser's functionality as an AI browser. The core breakthrough of the "AI+" mini-window lies in embedding AI seamlessly throughout the browsing process without disruption. While browsing, the mini-window remains on standby, instantly accessible without blocking content or interrupting reading or viewing flow. Users need not install additional plugins or leave the current page, as all QQ Browser's AI functions are available in a lightweight floating window for an ultra-light, on-demand experience. Beyond manual activation, QQ Browser proactively recommends the most relevant AI features based on the page type being viewed. For instance, it suggests "video summarization" when a video page is opened and prioritizes "webpage summarization" for long articles. Through intelligent analysis of URLs and page content structure, QQ Browser accurately anticipates user needs, delivering tailored and responsive support.

01 Conference Background
As oncology and cerebrovascular disease research enter an era of deep integration characterized by precision, multi-omics, and interdisciplinary approaches, a premier academic gathering of global expertise is set to take place in Shenzhen! From December 2-7, 2025, the Fourteenth International Workshop on Cancer Systems Biology (ICSB 2025) and the Longxing Program series will be held in Shenzhen. This conference marks the first expansion into the interdisciplinary field of cerebrovascular systems biology, inviting scholars worldwide to discuss breakthroughs in mechanisms, technological innovations, and clinical translation, establishing a high-level international platform for advancing precision medicine.

14 Years of Brand Legacy, Setting an Interdisciplinary Academic Benchmark
The International Workshop on Cancer Systems Biology (ICSB) and the Longxing Program, jointly initiated in 2011 by Professor Xu Ying of Southern University of Science and Technology and Professor Liang Yanchun of Jilin University, have consistently focused on breaking down disciplinary barriers, bridging basic and clinical research, and empowering young scholars. As a highly influential academic brand in the field, ICSB has successfully hosted 13 editions, attracting over 2,000 global participants, fostering more than 50 international research collaborations, and driving breakthroughs in cutting-edge areas such as AI + cancer omics and metabolic regulation in cerebrovascular diseases.

Deep Interdisciplinary Integration: Focusing on the dual domains of oncology and cerebrovascular systems.

Del 2 al 7 de diciembre de 2025, se celebrará en esta ciudad el Decimocuarto Taller Internacional de Biología de Sistemas del Cáncer (ICSB 2025), junto con las actividades del Programa Longxing. excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Akamai, a cloud service provider that supports and protects online life, announced a partnership with NVIDIA to launch the new Akamai Inference Cloud, an edge cloud platform specifically designed for AI inference. This means AI model inference and responses will no longer rely on computing power from distant data centers but will be completed closer to users and more quickly. According to Leifeng.com, the Akamai Inference Cloud integrates NVIDIA's latest-generation RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU and BlueField-3 DPU, making it one of the first cloud providers globally to adopt this GPU architecture. As the core computing component used in this collaboration, the NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell series was released in March 2025, supporting up to 96 GB of VRAM and 24K CUDA cores. The market widely views this card as a significant specification upgrade for the enterprise sector; for instance, Tom’s Hardware notes its VRAM capacity far exceeds that of typical consumer cards, such as the RTX 5090's 32 GB. For scenarios like AI inference, LLMs, and professional rendering, this GPU is considered key hardware for accelerating the shift toward the edge and professional markets, which is a major reason Akamai chose the RTX PRO 6000. The complexity of AI models has increased over the past two years.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Akamai, proveedor de servicios en la nube encargado de respaldar y proteger la vida en línea, anunció su colaboración con NVIDIA para lanzar la nueva Akamai Inference Cloud, una plataforma de nube perimetral diseñada específicamente para la inferencia de IA. Esto significa que la inferencia y respuesta de los modelos de IA ya no dependerán de la potencia de cálculo remota en centros de datos, sino que se realizarán más cerca de los usuarios y de forma más rápida. Según se conoció, Akamai Inference Cloud integra la última generación de NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU y BlueField-3 DPU, siendo una de las primeras plataformas a nivel mundial en adoptar esta tecnología.

excerpt_i18n.en:
At the Imagine Conference on October 28, NavInfo CEO Cheng Peng announced the rebranding from "NavInfo" (Navigation Information) to "SEEWAY.AI," symbolizing "vision with light, action with dimensions," marking a formal transition from an automotive company to an AI-focused one. 

Currently, NavInfo's revenue is split 30-70, with cloud, maps, and positioning accounting for 70%. In three years, this ratio will reverse, with AI-based orders and designated projects making up 70% and traditional business 30%.

In his speech, Cheng Peng detailed past explorations and lessons in areas like chips, assisted driving, and maps. In 2015, he noted that the automotive industry faced unresolved issues, such as core technologies like chips and assisted driving being monopolized by a few international giants. He stated that NavInfo aimed to challenge whether Chinese companies could develop their own automotive chips, create domestic assisted driving systems, and provide smart cockpit solutions.

Over the past decade, NavInfo has established major business segments: Smart Cloud, Smart Chip, Smart Cockpit, and Smart Driving, with Smart Driving driving integration across all products. For example, its chip business—AC8015/8025—can support certifications in 168 countries with a single hardware set. During the 2021 chip shortage, many automaker CEOs visited Cheng Peng's office seeking chips. Financial reports show that the chip business remains a crucial pillar for NavInfo, with gross margins second only to Smart Driving.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la actualidad, los ingresos de NavInfo se dividen en una proporción de tres a siete: nube, mapas y posicionamiento representan el setenta por ciento, y en tres años se invertirá esta relación. Los pedidos y proyectos que manejo, basados en inteligencia artificial, constituyen el setenta por ciento, mientras que los negocios tradicionales son el treinta por ciento. El 28 de octubre, en la Conferencia de Innovación, el CEO de NavInfo, Cheng Peng, anunció la actualización de la marca de "NavInfo" a "SEEWAY.AI", simbolizando "visión luminosa y acción dimensionada", marcando la transición oficial de "automotriz" a "inteligencia artificial". En su discurso, Cheng Peng detalló las motivaciones y lecciones aprendidas de sus exploraciones en chips, conducción asistida y mapas desde 2015.

excerpt_i18n.en: On November 4, the highly anticipated AI model real-time investment competition "Alpha Arena" concluded, with Alibaba's Qwen emerging as the ultimate champion. Organized by the third-party institution Nof1 on October 18, the contest gathered six top global models—Qwen3-Max, DeepSeek v3.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Grok 4—each starting with $10,000 in initial capital to make autonomous decisions and trades in real markets without human intervention, determining the winner based on profit and loss. Over 17 days, Alibaba's Qwen won with a return rate exceeding 20%, and Qwen and DeepSeek were the only two profitable models, while all four top U.S. models incurred losses, with GPT-5 at the bottom with over 60% loss. As AI models repeatedly set new highs on various performance benchmarks, evaluating their decision-making abilities in real, dynamic, and highly competitive environments has become a key focus in the AI arena. The "Alpha Arena" released by the U.S. AI research lab nof1.ai provided the six top models with $10,000 and real-time market prices and various indicators, allowing them to compete with real money in actual markets without any human intervention, enabling autonomous decision-making and trading by the AI.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 4 de noviembre concluyó el esperado torneo de inversión en tiempo real con modelos de IA "Alpha Arena", donde Alibaba Qwen se alzó con el título final. Organizado por la entidad independiente Nof1 el 18 de octubre, la competencia reunió a seis modelos líderes mundiales —Qwen3-Max, DeepSeek v3.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 y Grok 4—, cada uno con un capital inicial de diez mil dólares para operar de forma autónoma sin intervención humana en mercados reales, determinando al ganador según los resultados de ganancias y pérdidas. Tras 17 días, Alibaba Qwen resultó victorioso.

excerpt_i18n.en: AI generation technology is advancing rapidly, but video creation remains a high-barrier task. While generative AI offers unprecedented creative capabilities, the process remains fragmented. Creators must first write scripts, generate visuals with text-to-video tools, then handle voiceovers, editing, subtitles, pacing—each step relying on different software. Professional teams can streamline these stages with workflows, but for average creators, such division often means more time and learning effort. AI makes starting easier but hasn't made creation more seamless. The real breakthrough may not be bigger models or stronger computing power, but enabling AI to truly understand creativity and participate in creation. Only when these scattered steps are reconnected can ideas flow naturally. Future AI video creation might not involve adding more tools but forming a unified system—where text, images, and sound collaborate in one space, and conceptualizing, generating, and refining happen in the same context. Now, Kunlun Tech is gradually realizing this change. Introducing SkyReels: Seamless Creation. Kunlun Tech's latest SkyReels is born from this "reimagining creation" approach—not just another standalone tool, but a multimodal system that restores unity and flow to creation. In SkyReels, elements like images, videos, music, and voice narration are integrated.
